articles.lede: Saskatchewan Energy and Resources Minister Colleen Young has toured NexGen’s Rook I Project in the province’s Athabasca Basin, a proposed underground uranium mine and mill awaiting final federal approval before construction can begin. The project, which represents an estimated $2.2-billion initial investment, is expected to become one of the world’s largest uranium production facilities once operational. The Athabasca Basin is home to the largest high-grade uranium reserves globally. articles.lede: Missile from Yemen intercepted after sirens sound across central Israel. Sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol,” the military said in a statement. Earlier, the IDF had reported detecting a missile launch from Yemen and said air defense systems were engaging the threat. articles.title: SpaceX Prepares for 11th Test Flight of Its Starship Megarocket
articles.lede: SpaceX Prepares for 11th Test Flight of Its Starship Megarocket. SpaceX is gearing up for the eleventh test flight of its Starship megarocket, scheduled to launch from the company’s Starbase facility in Texas, Engadget reported. The launch window opens on October 13 at 7:15 p.m. Eastern Time, with a live broadcast set to begin 30 minutes before liftoff on SpaceX’s website and on the X platform. The most recent Starship flight took place successfully at the end of August, when the vehicle carried payload into orbit for the first time — eight Starlink test satellites — following a failed attempt earlier in the year.
